item.description: Beginning April 1, 2026, Greece will require all rent payments to be made through a bank account registered in the property owner’s name, according to tovima.com. item.title: Echoes from the past: Owl skyphos from Athens
item.description: The owl is one of the most famous symbols of ancient Greece.
